status: proposed-only; awaiting advisor selection after round1
scope: Elementary countermodels and a documentary admission gate, not new physical laws or proof of a corpus theorem
independence: Contract frozen before new peer reports. A second-round implementation may be independently compared with peers only after freeze.

experiments.input: H_n=diag(0,1/n,1), n positive integers; positive control K_n=diag(0,1,2)
experiments.requiredProof: For all n, gap(H_n)=1/n>0 but inf_n gap(H_n)=0; gap(K_n)=1 for all n
experiments.execution: Exact rational values for representative n and symbolic algebraic argument; no fit extrapolation
experiments.reject: Inferring a positive uniform physical gap solely from every sampled finite gap being positive
experiments.boundary: Elementary finite matrices; no claim that H_n is a Yang-Mills regulator

experiments.input: A=diag(1,2,3), B=diag(1,2,4), projection P onto first two coordinates
experiments.requiredProof: A and B positive and unequal; P(zI+A)^(-1)P* equals P(zI+B)^(-1)P* for z>0; full resolvents differ
experiments.execution: Exact rational resolvents at held-out positive z, plus all-z derivation
experiments.reject: Inferring full-operator equality from the declared partial readout
experiments.boundary: Finite-dimensional information-loss analogue, not a counterexample to full-data elasticity uniqueness

experiments.input: Explicit records for companion formalization, entropy/Wilson area-law mismatch, circuit/apparatus boundary mismatch, identical positive algebraic control
experiments.requiredProof: Report mismatch axes without treating field agreement as theorem verification
experiments.execution: Deterministic negative and positive record checks, with missing-data abstention
experiments.reject: Topic or family badge alone treated as exact solved overlap
experiments.boundary: Metadata-level audit only; no automated theorem equivalence claim

acceptance: Keep known controls and genuine inference limits visible
Separate analytic claims from finite computational samples
No additional round beyond user-requested two
